channel.title: DigitalShelf Labs
channel.description: 2027 planners and a rental property spreadsheet for small landlords from DigitalShelf Labs.

item.title: See Which Rental Leases End in the Next 30, 60 and 90 Days
item.description: The Lease Ends tab in the Landlord Tracker pulls every lease end date from your Leases tab and sorts it into next 30, 60 and 90 days. A flag shows when a renewal or notice is due based on each lease's notice period, so you can talk to tenants early. 1–10 units, any currency, .xlsx. Record-keeping only, not tax or accounting advice.

item.title: Plan Your 2027 Days Off on One Free Printable Page
item.description: Print the free 2027 one-page calendar, mark the dates you can't move, circle the days off you want, then check how they spread across the year before you book anything. No holidays are printed, so it works in any country. A4 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Not Sure Which 2027 Planner Style Fits You? Get All Three in One Bundle
item.description: Day-to-day planning, goals and habits, or a planner on your tablet: the 2027 Planner Bundle has all three styles, so you can use the one that fits each part of your life. 14 PDFs, A4, A5 and US Letter printables plus a hyperlinked tablet PDF, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: Every Day of 2027 in One Grid: A Year-at-a-Glance Planner Page
item.description: The Year at a glance page lays out all 365 days of 2027 as one grid, months across and days down, so you can shade trips, deadlines and busy weeks before they sneak up. It's one of 84 pages in the 2027 Minimal Planner. A4, A5 and US Letter, Monday or Sunday start.

item.title: A Simple Repairs Log for Landlords: Who Fixed What, What It Cost, What's Still Open
item.description: Log each repair with the date reported, unit, issue, contractor, cost and status. Add a follow-up date and the Repairs tab marks a job as overdue when it isn't done and that date has passed. Open repairs also show on the dashboard. Landlord Tracker, .xlsx for 1–10 units. Record-keeping only, not tax or accounting advice.

item.title: Keep Track of Boiler Services and Alarm Tests With a Recurring Maintenance Tab
item.description: List recurring jobs per unit, like a heating service, smoke and CO alarm tests or gutter cleaning, with how often they're due. The Landlord Tracker works out the next due date from the last one done and marks jobs due within 30 days in amber and overdue ones in red. .xlsx for 1–10 units. Record-keeping only, not tax or accounting advice.
